preconditions.description: The input text must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(char.isdigit() or char.isalpha() for char in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output string must contain only digits and alphabetic characters.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == '1' if text[i] == 'a' else return_value[i] == '2' if text[i] == 'e' else return_value[i] == '3' if text[i] == 'i' else return_value[i] == '4' if text[i] == 'o' else return_value[i] == '5' if text[i] == 'u' else return_value[i] == text[i] for i in range(len(text)))
postconditions.description: Each lowercase vowel in the input string is replaced by the corresponding number, while other characters remain unchanged.
